podcast.body: This song's chord structure is influenced by the "three-cord trick" pattern, which became a cornerstone of rock music, with roots traced to songs like Chuck Berry's "Havana Moon." "And between that and the influence of Havana Moon on records like Louis Louis and Wild Thing, the three-cord trick became one of the most important chord sequences in rock music."
